verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents its own API: an API Documentation page, API tokens, and a JMAP interface that supports OAuth 2.0 or Bearer tokens and lets a client query, fetch, and send in one HTTP request. That gives a self-built agent a documented path to read and send mail. Missing for 10: any first-party connector or MCP server for Claude or ChatGPT, explicit evidence of triage operations (moving, flagging, labeling) and draft creation through the API, Fastmail-specific API detail beyond page titles, and hands-on or independent reports of agents using it end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection

citations.quote: POST a `methodCalls` array. Query, fetch, and send, all in one HTTP request.
Standard OAuth 2.0 or Bearer tokens. No custom auth protocol to implement.
